lines.text: The LORD asks if a man can hide in secret places where He cannot see him, since He fills the heavens and the earth.
The prophets say "I had a dream!" and think their dreams will make the people forget His name, as their fathers did through worship of Asherah.
The LORD says the prophet with a dream should retell it, and His word is like fire and a hammer that smashes a rock.
The LORD is against prophets who buy words from the priests and prophesy false dreams, though He never sent them.
Those who claim "the burden of the LORD" will be forgotten and cast out, along with the city, and bear everlasting shame.
